roadmap.titleHighlight: around the global live streaming ecosystem
roadmap.description: From live streaming tools to platform capabilities, VicastCam is expanding across more devices, platforms, and live streaming scenarios.

items.title: Deepening mobile expertise, refining core green screen effects
items.text: Focused on the underlying capabilities of mobile virtual live streaming, we continuously iterated and optimized the green screen matting algorithm to solve issues like edge distortion, poor lighting adaptation, and lag with multiple overlays. We completed a full suite of virtual effects including stickers, background replacement, and foreground occlusion, establishing a lightweight mobile virtual live streaming foundation. With just a phone, ordinary creators can now achieve professional green screen live streaming.

items.title: Enabling screen casting, developing core virtual camera technology
items.text: We expanded device connectivity, focusing on high-definition phone screen casting and cross-device synchronized transmission. We independently developed a universal virtual camera driver for global software capture and output, enabling compatibility across live streaming software, editing tools, and online meetings. We filled the gap in screen sharing between mobile and desktop, allowing one-tap casting from phone to computer and multi-output virtual camera positions, enriching live streaming production.

items.title: Expanding to PC, launching a professional 3D live streaming assistant
items.text: We launched a professional desktop live streaming product line, building a complete 3D virtual live streaming assistant. It features 3D virtual scenes, digital human driving, multi-camera switching, and real-time lighting and rendering, suitable for commercial live streaming, virtual presentations in showrooms, and large-screen e-commerce live streaming. We also added multi-layer compositing, real-time captions, and interactive components to support team-scale, high-quality professional live streaming delivery.

items.title: Global market expansion, building a complete live streaming ecosystem
items.text: We are fully expanding into the global live streaming market, adapting to overseas mainstream live streaming platforms, low-latency transmission over international networks, and multi-language localization. We will integrate our three core products—mobile green screen, screen casting virtual camera, and PC 3D live streaming—to connect three business lines: individual creators, enterprise commercial use, and developer SDK integration. With hardware, software, multi-terminal, and domestic and international services unified, we will complete a full-cycle live streaming ecosystem from production, cross-device interoperability, to global distribution.
